# Phonon_Vortex

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
A topological excitation in a 2D crystal characterized by a quantized circulation of the phonon displacement field around a core. Provides a phononic analogue of topological defects that can encode or route information robustly in TCC and iNEST interconnect architectures.
